text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса does her best, but she's
no match
for Сайленс Судзука, the
Otherworldly
Front-Runner.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And afterward, she passes out from
pushing
herself beyond her limits.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
One thing has become painfully clear to
El
Condor Pasa—if there are racers like
Silence
Suzuka at the Japan Cup, she
doesn't stand a
chance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She hangs her head dejectedly as she
decides to
give up on her goal of
winning the Japan Cup in
her classic
year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
